title: Propagation Dynamics for Multidimensional Nonlocal Diffusion Equations: A General Freidlin-Gärtner Formula
summary: In this paper, we develop a unified geometric framework for the propagation dynamics of multidimensional nonlocal Fisher--KPP equations with asymmetric dispersal. In dimensions $N\geqslant2$, asymmetry leads to a multidimensional propagation geometry determined by the full family of minimal wave speeds, and the intrinsic spreading set may even fail to contain the origin. We show that the mean dispersal drift $\mathbf p=\int_{\mathbb R^N}x\mathcal J(x)dx$ provides a natural center for the spreading geometry, yielding a new drift-centered radial description.
